next_experiment_proposal.research_question: Does adding IS-11 (TABLE_CELL_CONTEXT) + IS-12 (ROW_COLUMN_POSITION) to the frozen IS-01/IS-02 feature set enable correct KEEP_SEPARATE decisions for table cell pairs that currently produce false positives?
next_experiment_proposal.independent_data: Requires new PDFs with table-heavy content (current 4 PDFs have 40 TABLE_CELL cases in universe, 11 sampled — insufficient for standalone experiment)

next_experiment_proposal.blind_protocol: Reviewers see only text_a, text_b, page_context — no IS features, no geometry, no machine prediction
